newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler Corp unit may issue $300 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler Corp unit may issue $300 mln in debt.

text.p: Chrysler Corp unit, Chrysler Financial is expected to tap the market with a $300 million debt offering, syndicate sources said on Thursday.
The deal is expected to consist of A3/A-minus rated three-year notes via lead underwriter JP Morgan Securities, sources added.
"Chrysler Financial's upcoming three-year notes are already issue-bid," one syndicate source said.
The offering which is already rumored to be meeting with good demand in its pre-announced stage, is expected to be launched later today, dealers said.
